name: The Lion Skin
s: Naeem, who has endured 15 years in prison for his daughter's love, faces a major crisis after his release to see her.

paragraphs.text: The Lion Skin () is an Iranian television series created by the brothers Jamshid and Navid Mahmoudi for Filmnet. It stars Hadi Hejazifar as the lead character, with Alireza Kamali, Shahab Hosseini, Pantea Bahram, Zhila Shahi, Mehrdad Sedighian, Pardis Ahmadieh and Behzad Khalaj.
